name: Shader wallpaper
author: Hurunagus
description: hyprglaze on the bar: whether the shader wallpaper is running, which effect and theme it shows, and per-monitor switches. Drives the omarchy-hyprglaze command, so the panel and the terminal do exactly the same thing.

barWidget.description: hyprglaze state on the bar with a popup: per-monitor on/off, effect, theme and audio reactivity.

schema.label: Show the current effect's name beside the icon
